description_short: Compute an efficiency-per-volt metric (EQE/Vol) for Er3+-based MOSLED host matrices and rank them by this indicator, jointly considering external quantum efficiency and operating voltage.

paper.title: Atomic and Molecular Layer Deposition of Functional Thin Films Based on Rare Earth Elements

paper_context.table_description: Performance characteristics of Er3+-based MOSLED devices fabricated by ALD: annealing temperature (Ann. T), external quantum efficiency (EQE), power efficiency (PE), threshold voltage (Vol), emission lifetime (τ), and operational device lifetime (OLT).

derived_metric.name: EQE-per-Volt
derived_metric.rounding: The metric is rounded to three decimal places in the SPARQL query via ROUND(1000 * (EQE/Vol)) / 1000.
derived_metric.motivation: Couples external quantum efficiency with operating voltage to identify host matrices that provide high emission efficiency at low electrical drive, approximating an efficiency-per-drive metric for MOSLED performance.

numeric_parsing.motivation: Table 5 values may include units, approximate signs (e.g. "≈"), and non-numeric placeholders such as "NG".
numeric_parsing.strategy: For each field (EQE, Vol, Ann. T, τ, OLT), the query converts the cell to a string and strips all non-numeric characters (except digits, decimal point, minus sign) using a regex, then casts the result to xsd:decimal.
numeric_parsing.missing_values: If a string does not contain any digit (e.g. "NG"), the corresponding numeric variable is left UNDEF. BOUND() checks ensure that rows without numeric EQE or voltage are excluded from the efficiency-per-volt calculation.

filters.validity_constraint: Rows must have both EQE and Vol present and Vol > 0 via FILTER(BOUND(?eqe_num) && BOUND(?vol_num) && ?vol_num > 0).
filters.domain_note: Since R1469991 models Er3+-based MOSLED devices, no explicit dopant filter is necessary; all rows correspond to the same dopant class.

postprocessing_notes.output_columns: The query returns host_matrix, eqe_num, vol_num, eqe_per_vol, anneal_num, tau_num, and olt_num, ordered primarily by decreasing eqe_per_vol, secondarily by increasing voltage, and then by decreasing EQE and host name.
postprocessing_notes.interpretation: The EQE-per-volt indicator does not replace detailed device modeling, but provides a simple comparative measure to highlight host matrices that combine high external quantum efficiency with low threshold voltage.
